page_data_script:
user = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Cafe User",
    {"handle": frappe.form_dict.handle},
    ["handle", "user"],
    as_dict=1,
)

if user.user != frappe.session.user:
    raise frappe.PermissionError("You don't have permission to view this page")

UserBookmark = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post Bookmark")
Post = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post")
CafeUser = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe User")

query = (
    frappe.qb.from_(UserBookmark)
    .inner_join(Post)
    .on(UserBookmark.post == Post.name)
    .select(
        Post.name,
        Post.title,
        Post.description,
        Post.cover_image,
        Post.reading_time,
        Post.slug,
        Post.creation,
    )
    .where(UserBookmark.owner == frappe.session.user)
)

data.posts = query.run(as_dict=True)

user_data = frappe.db.get_value(
    "User", frappe.form_dict.handle, ["full_name"], as_dict=1
)

breadcrumbs = [
    {"label": "Café", "url": "/cafe/explore"},
    {"label": user_data.full_name, "url": f"/cafe/profile/{user.handle}"},
    {"label": "Bookmarks", "url": "#"},
]

data.page_data = {
    "is_logged_in": frappe.session.user != "Guest",
    "breadcrumbs": breadcrumbs,
}
